dct_description_sm:
Brampton Plan-Schedule 6a-Conservation Authority Boundary polygons depicts border between Toronto and Region Conservation Authority and Credit Valley Conservation watersheds. An extract of the full polygon feature which defines the overall watershed area.

Conservation Authority Boundaries identify the geographic areas within the jurisdiction of the applicable conservation authorities. These areas are subject to watershed-based planning and environmental management programs that help protect property and people from natural hazards, as well as manage water resources and ecological systems.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
